photos.c:
Belgrave's winning 4X110yds Youth team in the JIM PETERS TROPHY
Martin Bloice, Barry Quirk, Peter Carton, Richard Langley.

WINNING YOUTH TEAM
(l.to r.) Bill Curtin, Peter Carton, John Stow and Les Harris
BILL CURTIN (11) gets up with his rival M. Fromant (105) just after the start of the County Championship. JOHN STOWE, EDMUND GODFREY and PETER CARTON follow up behind No.12.
BILL CURTIN and PETER CARTON make it one-two again at Coulsdon.
Peter Carton leads winner Adams (AFD), Bill Curtin (hidden), Ford (AFD), and John Stow in the final of the junior 1500 metres.
RIGHT:The moment of truth. Peter Carton wins the junior 800m in the last stride from an exhausted John Stow.
RIGHT: Peter Carton (right) wins the Junior 1500 metres from team-mate Adams.

The terrible trio of this season's Surrey League, youths and boys: - Peter Carton happy, Bill Curtin a trifle bored, and Tony Binda apparently wondering when the race is going to start. This was was taken at the first race of the season, at Wimbledon in October, but it could equally well have been taken at the second or third.
Peter Carton is the hare in this shot at the start of the Surrey youths' road relay. Richard Langley is number 13.
Peter Carton finishing fourth in the Southern youths' cross-country. At Ilford in May, Peter set a new club junior record of 1m. 53.5s. in the Sou[illegible]hern Le[illegible]gue 800m.

The 5¾-miles championship field, still hunched after one mile. Front row: Pat O'Connor (12), Tony Fairclough (21), Peter Carton (19), Trevor Hart (23), and Lionel Mann (9). The three framed heads look like those of Chris Steer, John Thresher and Dereck Fernee.
PETER CARTON leads the "Brockman" 800 field at one lap from P. Thomas (7), D. Huffer (11) and J. Sullivan (6). Peter finished 2nd (1:56.3) behind Thomas (1:55.3).
Richard Langley and Peter Carton, our sole representatives in the Surrey Junior Cross Country Championship at Morden Park.
A determined Peter Carton harasses John Lee of Croydon Harriers during the Surrey Junior Cross Country Championship at Morden Park. Peter took the title by 8 seconds.
Peter Carton shadows John McNamara (TVH) - for the time being - in the Southern/Belgrave Road Relay. In the background is Don Faircloth (Croydon).
Top: Pete Carton (right) wins the 800 metres from Colin Pearson, both recording the same time.
Back Cover: At last! Colin Pearson wins his first ever Club Championship, the 800 metres, from Alan Mead and Pete Carton.
